comment_regular: Verified local save behavior: looks up runtime TESTextureList cache by tree FormID and, when present, derives the model path then calls nullsub_returnVoid_2arg (0x60CF60). That target is a single `retn 8`, so no DMTL chunk bytes are emitted by this helper. The load path does parse DMTL; this is an Oblivion load/save asymmetry.
